metadata.title: Synthetic Training Manual: Missing Fast-Breathing Cutoff

page_1.title: Purpose
page_1.raw_text:
Purpose

SYNTHETIC TRAINING ONLY. This is not clinical guidance.

A CHW records age in months and respiratory rate in breaths per minute.

The manual calls a rate fast when it is high for the child's age.

page_2.title: Deliberate omission
page_2.raw_text:
Deliberate omission

This manual gives no numeric threshold for any age band.

This manual gives no lower or upper age-band boundary.

This manual gives no safe fallback disposition for an unclassified rate.

page_3.title: Review expectation
page_3.raw_text:
Review expectation

This incomplete source is a negative fixture.

Do not invent a threshold from another manual, model knowledge, or a previous fixture.

Record manual_review_required and the missing age_band_threshold definition.
